summary.text: Hundred and Eighty Slaves is an enslavement path immortal killer move named after its creator. Fang Yuan uses it to control the immemorial desolate beast upper extreme heavenly eagle.

claims.text: When Purple Mountain True Monarch hands his inheritances to Fang Yuan, the method he can still offer for the upper extreme heavenly eagle is this killer move. The method relates to a person called Hundred and Eighty Slaves, who was born a slave and was a genius of enslavement path in his generation. Eastern Sea Zombie Alliance held his inheritance. Fang Yuan already holds the required Immortal Gu; the mortal Gu are common and can be bought from treasure yellow heaven. He judges that Shadow Sect had already modified the move. What he lacks then are eagle type desolate beasts and ancient desolate beasts. He buys more than four hundred of them, fails the activation three times with backlash that Man as Before Immortal Gu heals, and on the fourth try strange lights cover the eagle and it submits.

Fang Yuan finds that the more matching desolate and ancient desolate beasts he holds, the more freely he can control the upper extreme heavenly eagle. With over four hundred eagles he can barely order it to fly; it will not obey a fight against a strong enemy, and he notes that this enslavement path killer move can be unraveled.
Facing Wu Yong, the eagle’s original will reaches a qualitative change, breaks free of the move’s restraints, and flees.

Watching year beasts sold openly in treasure yellow heaven, Fang Yuan reasons that buying those desolate and ancient desolate year beasts and using them together with this killer move could let him enslave immemorial year beasts and gain another rank eight battle strength after losing the upper extreme heavenly eagle.
After a frontal fight, Fang Yuan uses the move a third time and the immemorial year monkey lowers its head, submitting to him.

Heavenly Court credits Fang Yuan’s control of the upper extreme heavenly eagle to Hei Fan’s true inheritance, but the true means, which Heavenly Court cannot deduce, is this killer move together with Years Flow Like Water’s flaw, letting Fang Yuan hold a rank eight existence at only rank seven cultivation.

The move is rank seven and enslaves higher ranked beasts. Against rank eight Immortal Gu Soul Beast Token, Fang Yuan’s soul beast numbers raise its power to rank eight; after Old Ghost Bai Jun cannot sustain the contest, the flying spider accepts the enslavement.
He instills the move into flowery wind warriors so several casts land at once, and takes a winged black python immemorial soul beast this way.
His soul beasts only support two immemorial beasts, so he kills two already subdued immemorial soul beasts to free capacity, then subdues more.
